facts.text: The USF Tuition Promise covers full tuition for first-time full-time freshmen with at least a 3.0 GPA who are Pell-eligible and live on campus.

sources.title: USF Tuition Promise
sources.quote: USF is thrilled to announce that prospective students can now receive full tuition! To qualify, a student must meet all requirements: Enroll as a first-time, full-time freshman. Have a high school cumulative GPA of 3.0 or higher.
